chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad and another, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ziyād al-Qandī, from ʿAmmār al-Asadī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, regarding the saying:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “To Him ascends the good word, and the righteous deed raises it.”
“It is our wilayah, the Ahl al-Bayt,” and he gestured with his hand to his chest. “So whoever does not hold our wilayah, Allah will not raise any deed for him.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ: righteous deed that is elevated and accepted
key_terms.الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ: the good word that ascends to Allah
key_terms.لَمْ يَتَوَلَّنَا: does not take us as awliyāʾ / does not hold our wilayah
key_terms.وَلَايَتُنَا: our wilayah, meaning devotion and allegiance to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام interpret “To Him ascends the good word, and the righteous deed raises it” in relation to the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the verse as referring to the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as that by which righteous deeds are raised. It emphasizes that acceptance and elevation of deeds are tied to loyalty to them within Shia theological understanding.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad and someone else, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ziyad Al Qindy, from Ammar Al Asady, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[35:10] To Him do ascend the good words; and the good deeds lift them up

– our<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah of the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’, and he<sup>asws</sup> gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> hand to his<sup>asws</sup> chest, (then said): ‘So the one who does not have our<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Raise his deed for him’ (none of his deeds will be accepted).
en.sarwar: 85. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami from his father from Aban ibn Taghlib who has said the following. “I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, what is the meaning of the words of Allah, “Yet, he has not entered into ö aqaba.” [90:11]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “To whoever Allah has granted honor through our Wilaya (Leadership with Divine Authority) he has crossed the ö aqaba (the stage). We are the ö aqaba. Whoever would reach us gains his salvation.”

The narrator has said that he remained quite for a while and then said to me, “Would to learn a letter from that would be better for you than the whole world and all that is therein?” I said, “yes, May Allah take my soul in service for your cause.” He then said, “It is the setting free of a slave.” Then he said, “All people are slaves of fire. except you and your people. Allah has set you free from fire through our (Ahl al-Bayt) Wilaya (Leadership and Guardianship with Divine Authority).”
